The *Suvaṇṇavimānavatthu* ("Golden Mansion", Vv 78) is a canonical verse text preserved in the *Vimānavatthu* of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The text concerns the karmic rewards of meritorious giving, exploring specifically the fruits that result from building a monastery and offering it to the Buddha [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, four translations across four languages are recorded [SuttaCentral].
No curated cross-language parallels are cataloged on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral]. However, DharmaNexus records internal Pali text reuse, notably with the commentary, the *Vimānavatthu-aṭṭhakathā*, which shares 32 matching passages (spanning segments 0.4–12.4) [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Vimānavatthu* itself, verses in segments 6.4–10.2 are aligned by DharmaNexus with passages in the *Kaṇḍakavimānavatthu* (Vv 81, segments 12.1–15.3) across four matches [DharmaNexus]. In cross-tradition alignments, DharmaNexus detects low-scoring automated textual matches with the Tibetan translation of the *Ārya-mahāvajrameruśikharakūṭāgāra-dhāraṇī* (D0751) [DharmaNexus].
